title: AIADMK announces protests across Tamil Nadu against TVK government on December 2

ai.summary: AIADMK announced state-wide protests in Tamil Nadu on December 2 against TVK government for failing to meet electoral promises, deteriorating law and order, and women's safety issues.

facts.claim: AIADMK announced State-wide protests by his party on December 2
facts.quote: AIADMK general secretary Edappadi K. Palaniswami on Thursday (November 26, 2026) announced State-wide protests by his party on December 2

facts.claim: accusing the TVK government of failing to fulfil its electoral promises
facts.quote: accusing the TVK government of failing to fulfil its electoral promises

facts.claim: alleged deterioration of law and order situation
facts.quote: alleged deterioration of law and order situation

facts.claim: incidents of murder, robbery, drug trafficking, sexual violence and custodial deaths had become frequent
facts.quote: incidents of murder, robbery, drug trafficking, sexual violence and custodial deaths had become frequent

facts.claim: the government had failed to take effective action
facts.quote: the government had failed to take effective action

facts.claim: the government had completed six months in office but had pushed the State backwards on several fronts
facts.quote: the government had completed six months in office but had pushed the State backwards on several fronts

facts.claim: the government had failed to ensure women’s safety
facts.quote: the government had failed to ensure women’s safety

facts.claim: the government had failed to curb the drug menace
facts.quote: the government had failed to curb the drug menace

facts.claim: the government had failed to protect public property
facts.quote: the government had failed to protect public property

facts.claim: the administration was more concerned about retaining power than addressing people’s problems
facts.quote: the administration was more concerned about retaining power than addressing people’s problems

ai.background_note: AIADMK announced protests against TVK government for failing to meet electoral promises and deteriorating law and order in Tamil Nadu.
